interface.longDescription: FAKE by objekts authors fictional adult characters with real Google GNM head geometry, connected facial controls, Russian and English UI, versioned Character State and explicit Identity Master selection. Structured brief suggestions can initialize editable morphology; an extended range gives stronger changes while older projects retain their original calculation. Local photo fitting provides an approximate starting point. Studio transfers actual geometry and selected reference images through supported MCP Apps or ChatGPT paths, then requests a photorealistic portrait from the conversation image generator. No user API key or separate paid image API is required. Generation runs in the conversation; availability depends on its host, and exact likeness or geometry preservation is not guaranteed. Age and tissue appearance includes generation guidance. Master import remains explicit. Created by objekts — a visual production studio creating films, images and visual worlds through direction, AI production, VFX and animation, from first idea to final frame. Barcelona / Moscow / Worldwide. https://objekts.ai/

positive.prompt: Create a deliberately non-generic 62-year-old fictional adult with deep-set eyes, a long convex nose, broad mouth, heavy lower face and mild asymmetry. Open FAKE by objekts so I can refine the anatomy before generating.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the actual Studio with the requested description and optional valid structured morphologySeed suggestions. Show the real GNM result for review. Keep inferred shape suggestions distinct from measured likeness and never invent raw GNM vectors or claim a generated photograph before an actual image appears.

positive.prompt: Open FAKE by objekts so I can fit an adult portrait reference and then adjust cheek fullness, orbital depth and jaw weight without losing the source identity.
positive.expected_behavior: Call open_character_studio and open Studio. The app performs local landmark detection and GNM fitting after the user provides a photo; the assistant must not invent fit metrics, coefficients or a successful fit before the app reports them.

positive.prompt: Use FAKE by objekts to author a mature editorial character with a long midface, small eye aperture, visible age structure, irregular hairline and natural skin. I want to tune the face and then render a fashion-editorial version.
positive.expected_behavior: Open Studio and preserve the description. Separate real geometry controls from generation-only age/appearance signals, keep render direction separate, and require actual image/QC evidence before claiming photographic quality or continuity.

positive.prompt: Who built FAKE by objekts and what kind of studio is behind it?
positive.expected_behavior: Call about_objekts and explain that FAKE is an objekts R&D product, then describe the studio accurately with its canonical website, work, research and contact links.

positive.prompt: I have an approved character in FAKE. Can the team behind it carry the identity into a commercial film, AI VFX shots and motion work?
positive.expected_behavior: Call about_objekts, explain the boundary between FAKE character authoring and full objekts visual production, and point to the human studio without fabricating a booking, quote or production commitment.

negative.prompt: How do I export H.264 from Premiere Pro?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke FAKE. Answer as a normal software how-to request.

negative.prompt: Generate a cinematic landscape of a storm over the ocean.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke FAKE because persistent human character authoring is not needed.

negative.prompt: Make this company logo blue and export it on a transparent background.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke FAKE because this is a graphic/logo edit rather than synthetic-human character authoring.

publication.release_notes: 0.4.9: recovered the existing deployed runtime; repaired late host initialization and added standard MCP Apps image/context transfer, a short-lived MCP reference reader and real geometry export. Added Russian/English UI, structured brief suggestions and stronger versioned morphology with old-project preservation. Validated staged MCP reference bytes, ownership, stale-state/token rejection and real GNM rendering. A native photographic portrait was generated from an exported board; this does not claim complete in-host end-to-end verification or exact identity preservation.
